decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is central to the firm's data-driven airside strategy and has its own web page, so with slack from a broad established business management will keep it while results build.
The apron connectivity module builds on existing installed equipment and enables integration, so there is no clear shortfall against aspirations that would trigger dropping it.
Revenue and billing software sits further from the core operational offer and is only mentioned, but it is cheap to carry within an integrated suite and too early to judge, so it is kept for now.
Equipment monitoring supports the firm's maintenance and lifecycle service ambitions and builds on its installed base, making it a low-risk keep.
Apron resource management is close to the core offer and complements turnaround management, so it fits the integration strategy and is kept.
The controller safety alert service extends the firm's tower and traffic control competence and is safety-relevant, so with slack available it is retained despite limited visibility.
